NeuroTrace Clinical Operations — Scheduling & Escalation Policy

Purpose
This document provides guidance for scheduling patient follow-ups and escalating urgent operational issues.

Standard Scheduling Window
- Routine follow-up appointments should be scheduled within 7 business days of request.
- Urgent clinical follow-ups (e.g., abnormal test results requiring action) should be scheduled within 24 hours.

Escalation Contacts
- For scheduling system outages: paging on-call ops at ops-oncall@neurotrace.example.org or call +1-555-0101 and select option 2.
- For clinical escalation (unexpected safety concerns): contact Clinical Lead (clinical-lead@neurotrace.example.org) and the Duty Physician at +1-555-0202.

Cancellation & Rescheduling
- If a patient cancels with <24 hours notice, schedulers should offer two alternative windows within the next 5 business days.

After-hours and Holidays
- The on-call team covers nights and weekends; use the on-call contact for urgent operational failures.
- During major US holidays the reduced-staff policy applies; non-urgent scheduling requests will be deferred.

Documentation
- All scheduling decisions and escalations must be recorded in the ticketing system with the ticket ID and contact names.

Purpose note: This example policy is intentionally concise for demonstration and testing of retrieval behavior.
